sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: German architecture studio Holzrausch drew inspiration from cinematic interiors when designing this townhouse in Munich, which combines dark wood with natural stone and lush tropical planting. The clients for the Private Club project are film producer Cornelia Popp and her husband, who created a storyboard evoking 1970s South American movies as inspiration for the project. The post Holzrausch evokes South American cinema at renovated Munich townhouse appeared first on Dezeen .
